svg.title: Roster punch and approval support for daily time
svg.desc: Roster punch and approval support for daily time. Shift definitions and assignments lead to roster evidence. Roster links to absence, overtime approval, and raw punches; approval and punches support daily time. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
